test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. Some of them are sitting at the corners, while some are sitting at the middle of the sides. R sits third to the left of U. R sits at one of the corners. T does not sit at any of the corners. V sits second on the right of T. T is not an immediate neighbour of R. Only three people sit between S and Q. S is an immediate neighbour of W. S does not sit at any of the middle of the sides.

Who sits second to the left of V?
solution: From the given information: Step 1: R sits third to the left of U. R sits at one of the corners. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d7d4914e356af62888686a9e5615a4d781f2080b2049706cc85fcd6f1835abc.png] We place R at any corner and then place U third to the right of R. Step 2: T does not sit at any of the corners. V sits second on the right of T. T is not an immediate neighbour of R.
